name: navigation-pop-back-several-screens
description: A pop back several screens in one step: pop with `skippedInstanceIds` (the routes between the target and `departing`, top first). Home, cart, shipping and payment are pushed; a tap on `Back to home` pops payment with shipping and cart skipped. One route_pop: routeStack is [/home] (stackRevision 1), fromRouteInstanceId is the screen that was on top (payment), and the tap that was down when it arrived is its cause (causeEventId, causedByInteractionId, navigationOrigin interaction), as for a one-screen pop. The next push stacks on home only.
